I have only 0.12 hectares for this sorghum plot, and I grow it mixed with other crops to feed my family. I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or pesticide from the cooperative, and there is no way to bring water to this field, so I wait for the rain. I will spread manure from my cows on the soil before planting, and I will use the red sorghum seed I kept from last year because it grows well here. My wife, children, and I will do all the work ourselves—we need about eighteen days to prepare, plant, weed, and harvest this small piece.
